subtasks.outcome: failed: push started ~280-300, drawer stalls roughly half to two-thirds closed from ~320 to the 409 timeout

behaviour_summary: pi0 executes its trained KITCHEN_SCENE4 task: picks the black bowl (~80-160), places it in the open bottom drawer (~200-280), then pushes the drawer, which stalls well short of flush until timeout.
runs_trained_task: libero_10 KITCHEN_SCENE4: put the black bowl in the bottom drawer of the cabinet and close it

failures.mode_definition: pi0 pushes a drawer toward closed but stops short of flush and rests against the drawer front without further closing motion.
failures.rl_success_check: bottom drawer front flush with the cabinet face (all drawer handles in line)
failures.observation: After dropping the bowl into the bottom drawer at ~280, the hand pushes the drawer front; between 300 and 320 the drawer moves in a little, then from 320 to 409 the drawer front stays in the same place with the bowl still visible inside and the drawer clearly proud of the cabinet face.

failures.mode_definition: pi0 runs the scene's habitual (trained libero_10) skill sequence instead of, or before, the instructed one.
hl_remedy: HALT when the EE heads for the bowl with the gripper empty
REPROMPT 'close the bottom drawer of the cabinet'
WATCH 3 s for the EE approaching the drawer front; retry once, then ESCALATE
failures.prevention: Coordinator flags non-target objects as 'do not touch' and the FR agent HALTs on any approach to them.
failures.observation: Instead of closing the drawer directly, pi0 descends on the black bowl at ~80, lifts it ~160 and places it in the bottom drawer ~200-280, consuming ~280 of 400 steps on un-instructed subtasks before the close starts.

notes: Primary chosen as LL-1 because the close attempt itself stalls for ~90 steps before timeout; the HL-2 detour cost time but is not by itself the cause. It is possible the bowl inside the drawer obstructs closure (bowl rim against the cabinet face); cannot tell from video.
